page.layout: One page of text in a single wide column, with an empty narrow margin on the left and no marginal notes. Running head "NOTÆ." at the top, page number 102 at upper left. Catchword "confectum" at lower right.

main_text.p: Alokaisar, eidem Idoli nomen quod في مشارق الشام i.e. in arientali Syria Damascena plaga positum à tribus non una cultum refert Safioddinus. بغ Bag, a quo (ut quibusdam, teste Abul Feda videtur) urbs Bagdad nomen cepit, ut Persicè Bag dedit, seu Bagi donum sonet, Persarum seu Indorum, à quibus oriundus Eunuchus iste qui hoc nomen imposuit, potiùs quam Arabum Idolum fuisse puto: يعبدونه في الشرق [?] inquit, i. in Oriente illud colebant. Idoli à Bani Salim culti, ac à Gamio Ebn AbdolVazza ipsius æditiuo pro merito suo tractati, nomen licèt non expresserit AlEirauzabadius, non indigna tamen sunt memoratu quæ narrat. Spectante sc. æditiuo, sed officii sui (ut videtur) negligentiore, accurrentes vulpeculæ duæ Idoli confcensi caput urinâ cansurcârunt: ille indignum cultu suo Dominum ratus, qui hæc inultus pateretur, in hæc verba prorupit,
أرب يبول التعلبان براهمة لقد ذلت من بالت علمة تعالب
i. e. Num ille Dominus est, super cujus caput mingunt vulpes?

p.i: Certè vilè est super quem minxerint vulpes.

main_text.p: O Solaimenses, certè nec obest hic nec prodest, nec largitur, nec impedit, correptumque Idolum confregit. Contigit hoc post Mahammedem natum, qui in boni facti memoriam nomen ejus غاوي بن عبد العزى Gavi Ebn Abdiluzza, i. e. "Errans filius cultoris Vzza, magis fausto, sc. راشد بن عبد ربه Rashed Ebn Abd Rabbebi, i e. Orthodoxus filius cultoris Dominisui, commutavit. Nec magis injurii erga Deum suum Bani Hanifa, seu Hanifida, quos Idolum è massâ quâdam

page.notes: Arabic passages are transcribed from the scan and may contain small errors; doubtful letters are not individually marked. The Arabic on the first line of the verse and in the "Bag" entry was read with uncertainty and should be checked against the original. The first paragraph begins mid-entry, so it is marked as a continuation from the previous page. The catchword "confectum" is set alone at the right below the last full line.
